kaps_punt: Skakel tussen die holistiese en Westerse vorme van die genesing van vandag

items.bewering: Twee maniere van genees staan vandag naas mekaar in ons land.
items.blok: Twee maniere van genees in een land
items.bron: NWU Institutional Repository (Traditional Health Practitioners Act 22 of 2007: strengths and weaknesses, repository.nwu.ac.za): a large share of South Africans consult traditional practitioners while the public clinic system runs beside them; PMG Question NW3848 (pmg.org.za/committee-question/39030) on the statutory council for traditional health practitioners alongside the formal health system.

items.bewering: Inheemse genesing is geneig om na die hele mens te kyk, sy gees en sy liggaam saam. So 'n manier van kyk sluit ook sy gevoelens en die mense om hom in.
items.blok: Twee maniere van genees in een land
items.bron: Purdue University thesis 'Holistic Conceptions of Healing among Zulu Traditional Healers of South Africa' (hammer.purdue.edu): Zulu healing involves family, community, ancestors and spiritual forces together; UKZN paper (researchspace.ukzn.ac.za) citing Bodibe (1992) on traditional healing as holistic (physical, mental, social). 'Is geneig' is the right strength: CAPS itself notes that not all indigenous practice is spiritual, and many healers work with herbs only.

items.bewering: Daarby bevat inheemse genesing baie kennis van plante wat as medisyne gebruik word.
items.blok: Twee maniere van genees in een land
items.bron: Brendler & van Wyk, 'A historical, scientific and commercial perspective on the medicinal use of Pelargonium sidoides', J Ethnopharmacol 2008 (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18725280; pure.uj.ac.za): long traditional use of medicinal plants by indigenous peoples of southern Africa.

items.bewering: Westerse medisyne word veral met siektes van die liggaam self verbind.
items.blok: Twee maniere van genees in een land
items.bron: SAGE Encyclopedia of Anthropology, 'Biomedicine' (sk.sagepub.com): biomedicine holds that illness is largely caused by deviations from biological norms; Engel 1977, Science 196:129-36 (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/847460): the dominant biomedical model defines disease in somatic terms. 'Veral' keeps it from being absolute, which is correct.

items.bewering: Dit bou op wetenskap, tegnologie en kennis wat veral in Wes-Europa en Noord-Amerika gegroei het.
items.blok: Twee maniere van genees in een land
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'western medicine' (oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com): the medical treatment standard in Europe and North America, relying on scientific methods; Lumen Learning, Anthropological Approaches to Health and Medicine (courses.lumenlearning.com): biomedicine developed through the Scientific Revolution in Europe.

items.bewering: Jy het hierdie kwartaal geleer van die groot ontdekkings wat daaruit gekom het.
items.blok: Twee maniere van genees in een land
items.bron: KABV Sosiale Wetenskappe Gr 4-6, gedrukte bl. 45 (Gr 6 Geskiedenis Kwartaal 4, 'Medisyne oor tyd heen'): the same term carries 'Sommige moderne Westerse wetenskaplike mediese ontdekkings' (Jenner, Pasteur, Koch, Fleming, the first heart transplant) before this cluster. A curriculum cross-reference, not an outside fact.

items.bewering: In die verlede het Westerse medisyne die skakel tussen die geestelike en die fisiese dikwels verwaarloos. 'n Dokter het na die siek deel van die liggaam gekyk en nie altyd na die hele mens nie.
items.blok: Wat Westerse medisyne vroeër oorgeslaan het
items.bron: Engel, 'The need for a new medical model: a challenge for biomedicine', Science 1977;196(4286):129-36 (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/847460; URMC copy): the biomedical model 'leaves no room within its framework for the social, psychological, and behavioral dimensions of illness'. 'Dikwels' and 'nie altyd nie' are the right strength.

items.bewering: 'n Meer holistiese benadering is nou algemeen deel van die onderrig in die meeste Westerse mediese skole.
items.blok: Wat mediese skole nou ook leer
items.bron: Duke Center for Spirituality, Theology and Health, National Survey of Academic Leaders (spiritualityandhealth.duke.edu/index.php/research/survey/; Koenig et al. 2010): about 90% of US medical schools reported content on spirituality and health, mostly inside required courses; survey of US schools (pubmed 11382261): psychosocial factors taught by 80-93% of responding schools; Engel's biopsychosocial model proposed as 'a framework for teaching'. 'Deel van die onderrig' matches the evidence, which is content embedded in courses rather than stand-alone courses. Evidence is strongest for North American schools.

items.bewering: 'n Student by so 'n skool word geleer om na die hele mens te vra. Hy vra ook na die mens se lewe, sy familie en wat hom pla. Hy vra nie net na die siek deel van die liggaam nie.
items.blok: Wat mediese skole nou ook leer
items.bron: Same survey evidence as above (psychosocial factors such as stress and social support taught at 80-93% of schools; spirituality content at about 90%); Engel 1977 biopsychosocial model as the teaching framework. Asking about the patient's life, family and concerns is the social and family history of standard history-taking.

items.bewering: Die siekte is dan net een deel van die hele storie. Dit is wat die meeste mediese skole vandag vir nuwe dokters leer.
items.blok: Wat mediese skole nou ook leer
items.bron: Duke survey and US curriculum survey as above. Read in its block, which opens with 'die meeste Westerse mediese skole' and then 'so 'n skool', the sentence refers to Western schools and the evidence supports it. Note for a person: read on its own, the sentence drops 'Westerse' and could be taken to mean medical schools worldwide, for which no evidence was sought. The metaphor 'een deel van die hele storie' maps correctly onto the biopsychosocial view (disease as one factor among psychological and social ones).

items.bewering: Baie mense in Suid-Afrika gaan na 'n kliniek of 'n dokter én na 'n tradisionele geneser. Soms gebeur dit selfs met dieselfde siekte.
items.blok: Een mens wat albei gebruik
items.bron: BMC Infectious Diseases 2008, 8:72, Table 2 (bmcinfectdis.biomedcentral.com): 14.4% of TB patients diagnosed in a South African high-HIV setting had also visited a traditional healer; Durban ART clinic study (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4262581 and related): patients on antiretrovirals also used traditional medicine; NWU paper estimating wide consultation of traditional practitioners. 'Baie' is not a number and is safe; the often-quoted 70-80% figure is not used, which is right, as it is poorly sourced.

items.bewering: Party mense kry by die kliniek medisyne en gaan ook by 'n geneser hoor waarom hulle siek geword het.
items.blok: Een mens wat albei gebruik
items.bron: Durban HIV clinic study (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4262581): patients 'employ TAM and ART for distinctly different needs', not as alternatives; Platfontein clinic survey (open.uct.ac.za): most respondents held that illness can be caused by a spell, a cause addressed by healers rather than the clinic. 'Party mense' is the right strength.

items.bewering: Van die genesers en die werkers by 'n kliniek werk vandag saam. So 'n geneser stuur 'n siek mens soms na die kliniek toe. Hy doen dit wanneer hy sien dat die kliniek die regte plek vir daardie siekte is. ... Nie alle genesers werk so nie.
items.blok: Wanneer 'n geneser na die kliniek verwys
items.bron: Wits University / The Conversation, 'Why traditional healers could have a role to play in fighting HIV' (wits.ac.za, 2017/2018): about 85% of healers in a rural South African study referred patients for HIV testing at public facilities; Health-e News, 'Traditional healers say referral system with public clinics needs to work both ways' (health-e.org.za): healers refer patients to clinics; qualitative study of 30 rural healers: collaboration exists in an ad hoc manner. 'Van die', 'soms' and 'nie alle' match this.

items.bewering: Ons noem dit 'n verwysing wanneer 'n siek mens so na 'n ander plek gestuur word.
items.blok: Wanneer 'n geneser na die kliniek verwys
items.bron: Health-e News on the healer-clinic 'referral system' (health-e.org.za); 'verwysing' is the standard Afrikaans health-care term for a referral.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika het in 2007 'n wet gemaak wat tradisionele genesers erken.
items.blok: Die wet erken tradisionele genesers
items.bron: Traditional Health Practitioners Act, 2007 (Act No. 22 of 2007), Acts Online (source.acts.co.za) and PMG bill page B20-2007 (pmg.org.za/bill/462): bill introduced and passed by Parliament in 2007 after the Constitutional Court struck down the 2004 Act in August 2006; the Act provides a regulatory framework for traditional health practitioners and their registration. Precision note for a person, not a fault: the President assented on 6/7 January 2008 and it was gazetted on 10 January 2008 (Gazette 30660, Notice 42 of 2008). The Act's official year is 2007, so 'in 2007 'n wet gemaak' holds; 'in 2008 onderteken' would also be true.

items.bewering: Die wet het ook 'n raad vir hierdie genesers ingestel. Die werk van 'n geneser is daarmee 'n beroep wat die wet erken.
items.blok: Die wet erken tradisionele genesers
items.bron: Act 22 of 2007, section 4 (shop.acts.co.za, 'Establishment of Interim Traditional Health Practitioners Council'): establishes the Interim Traditional Health Practitioners Council of South Africa; long title: regulatory framework for the registration, training and practice of traditional health practitioners. PMG Question NW3848: section 4 was brought into operation on 1 May 2014 and the council's current term runs to 2028. The council in the Act is formally the 'Interim' council; the lesson's 'n raad' is accurate without that word.

items.bewering: Sommige plante wat genesers al lank gebruik, word vandag ook deur farmaseutiese maatskappye ondersoek. Party van hierdie plante word selfs as medisyne verkoop.
items.blok: Dieselfde plante, twee soorte kennis
items.bron: Brendler & van Wyk 2008, J Ethnopharmacol (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18725280): Pelargonium sidoides, a traditional southern African remedy, is made by Dr. Willmar Schwabe Pharmaceuticals as EPs 7630 (Umckaloabo), approved by the European Medicines Agency and backed by clinical studies; Frontiers in Pharmacology 2023 'Stevens' Cure (Umckaloabo)'.

items.bewering: Die geneser se kennis van plante en die navorser se werk kom hier by dieselfde plant uit.
items.blok: Dieselfde plante, twee soorte kennis
items.bron: Brendler & van Wyk 2008 (as above): the commercial and scientific development of P. sidoides began from its traditional use.

items.bewering: Die twee vorme van genesing bestaan vandag naas mekaar in Suid-Afrika. Nie een van die twee het die ander een vervang nie. Hulle raak mekaar by die pasiënt en by die kliniek. Hulle raak mekaar ook by die wet en by die plante.
items.blok: Wat vandag naas mekaar staan
items.bron: Summary of the claims verified above: concurrent use (BMC Infect Dis 2008; Durban ART study), clinic referral (Wits; Health-e), Act 22 of 2007 (Acts Online; PMG), plant research (Brendler & van Wyk 2008).

items.bewering: Holisties beteken om na die geheel te kyk en nie net na los dele nie, en by 'n mens is daardie geheel meer as sy liggaam alleen: ook sy gees, sy gevoelens en die mense om hom.
items.blok: holisties
items.bron: UKZN paper (researchspace.ukzn.ac.za) on the holistic view of health and healing (physical, mental and social well-being, after the WHO definition); Purdue thesis on Zulu holistic healing (family, community, spirit). The definition is accurate when read alone.

items.bewering: Wanneer 'n pasiënt na 'n ander plek of persoon toe gestuur word vir hulp.
items.blok: verwysing
items.bron: Health-e News on healer-clinic referral (health-e.org.za); standard meaning of a medical referral. Accurate when read alone.

items.bewering: Wat met die maak van medisyne te doen het.
items.blok: farmaseuties
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'pharmaceutical' (adjective): 'connected with making and selling medical drugs'. The lesson leaves out the selling, which narrows it but does not make it false.

opsomming: Every checkable claim is supported by sources, with nothing contradicted or uncertain; there are no 'first' or 'oldest' claims and no analogy whose mapping misleads, and the two 'die meeste mediese skole' quantifiers hold for Western schools (about 90% of US schools teach spirituality and psychosocial content) — though the block's last sentence drops 'Westerse', and the 2007 Act was signed in January 2008, which the wording still allows.
